A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have extended many of the results for Banach spaces to the non-commu- tative setting of operator space.

we have introduced a new class of operator spaces, namely, one-sided $M/L$-embedded operator space, which is a natural generalization of $M/L$ embedded Banach spaces, and we have investigated several of their properties.
a large class of non-commutative operator spaces, which are one-sided ideals in their biduals, are studied in this thesis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the non-commutatative analogue of $M$-embedding and $L$-embedding coincide.
the classical theory of $M$-spaces can be extended to the non-commuative setting of operator theory and the theory of $M^*$-spaces can be viewed as a dual theory.
